items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I had heard Louie and Oliver -- I had heard Louie's record and after hearing Louie, oh, I made arrangements of a lot of Louie's stuff. I made arrangements on Snag for the band that we played with.

ctx.x: uh-huh. And what kind of tunes did you plan then? Did you play some blues by then?
Well, we played all kinds -- we played blues, we played 'Snag It' -- that's one of Louie's and Joe Oliver's numbers.
Yes. Did you play the break -- da-da-da-da-da-da-
